22
"Q picks up the brush and W the eraser - the Keyboard Shortcuts settings page lets you point them at other keys."
"Hold ALT and drag with the right mouse button over a picture to change the brush size and how soft its edge is."
"Hold ALT and roll the mouse wheel over a picture to change how opaque the brush paints."
"SHIFT-click after a stroke to paint a straight line from wherever the last stroke ended."
"The brush outline follows the pointer even outside the picture, so a stroke starts where you can see it starting."
"Ctrl+Z takes back exactly one stroke, so painting is never a one-way trip."
"A light halo left around a soft stroke is the brush painting at partial alpha, not a broken brush."
"Open the Actor Constructor from the toolbar to change an actor's flags, properties and states without typing DECORATE by hand."
"The constructor follows the text cursor: put the cursor anywhere inside an actor and that is the actor you are editing."
"A value field in the constructor says what the engine expects there - INT, FLOAT or a quoted STRING - before you type it."
"Greyed entries in the constructor's Actions list are state actions the engine still takes but discourages."
"Hover a sprite frame name in a state line to see the picture behind it; hold SHIFT to play the whole block."
"A file holding changes that nobody has open is gold and slanted in the entry tree."
"Closing an entry tab asks you nothing: the picture goes into the file, and the tree marks the file until it is saved."
"Double-click an entry to open it in its own tab; the panel on the right keeps showing whatever is selected."
"Entries can be bookmarked to jump between frequently used ones, even across different archives."
"The Archive Manager panel, with its bookmarks and extended recent list, is one Ctrl+1 away."
"The Filter box under the entry list takes wildcards, so '*.png' narrows a big archive down at once."
"If graphics come up in greyscale, a Base Resource Archive is probably missing or the wrong palette is selected."
"Drag with the middle mouse button to move the viewpoint around an image or a texture."
"Be sure to set up a Base Resource Archive; the Base Resource toolbar switches between them."
"Renaming several selected entries at once offers both a mask and a one-by-one prompt."
